notes.title: Unlock New Dimensions of Learning with Memory Shards and the Temporal Tablet
notes.notes:
Hello, adventurers!

We’re thrilled to announce that our latest update for Hua Mulan: A Chinese Learning Adventure is now live! This release brings you two exciting new features—Memory Shards and the Temporal Tablet—along with a host of bug fixes and gameplay improvements inspired by your feedback.

[h2]Memory Shards: Track and Master Vocabulary in a New Dimension[/h2]
We understand the importance of reinforcing the words and phrases you encounter, so we’ve added Memory Shards as an interactive way to practice. Now, whenever you get a word wrong in a conversation, a new Memory Shard is created in the game world. Equip the EchoSpect Goggles to view the world through the time void, where you can track down and engage with these Memory Shards to master your vocabulary.

[h3]New Gameplay Details:[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]EchoSpec Goggles[/b]: Put these on to reveal Memory Shards scattered across the environment. The time void effect gives you a glimpse into hidden dimensions, showing where you need to focus your vocabulary practice.
[*] [b]Pulse Feature[/b]: Left-click to send out a pulse that will guide you to the nearest Memory Shard and show a countdown of how many remain to be collected.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42001728/d1f398e258e0b04309048ae05549bc1877b44384.png[/img]

[h2]Temporal Tablet: In-Game Dictionary, Quest Log, and Progress Tracking[/h2]
Responding to your requests for an in-game dictionary, we’ve packed the Temporal Tablet with powerful features:

[list]
[*] [b]Vocabulary Dictionary[/b]: Track all the words you’re learning in Hua Mulan, including those that need extra practice.
[*] [b]Quest Log[/b]: View both active and completed quests to keep track of your progress.
[*] [b]Progress Overview[/b]: Check out your learning journey at a glance, with detailed insights on vocabulary mastery and gameplay achievements.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42001728/c36a93e09393ee76e6240cee54156963430e6c86.png[/img]

[h2]Bug Fixes and Gameplay Improvements[/h2]
This update also includes a range of bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements. Here’s a highlight of what’s changed:

[list]
[*] [b]Improved NPC Interactions[/b]: Dialogue and response times have been optimized to make conversations smoother.
[*] [b]Enhanced Quest Tracking[/b]: You can now see your quest progress more clearly with the updated interface.
[*] [b]Performance Optimization[/b]: The game should feel more fluid and responsive, especially in high-action sequences.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy these new features and updates, designed to make your learning adventure even more immersive and personalized. We’ll continue to listen to your feedback, so keep sharing your thoughts!

Happy exploring and learning!

The Odeum Team

notes.title: Upcoming Features: Time Shards and the Temporal Tablet [Dev Blog]
notes.notes:
Greetings, adventurers!

We’re excited to share a sneak peek at two new features we’re working on for Hua Mulan: A Chinese Learning Adventure—Time Shards and the Temporal Tablet. These additions are designed to elevate your learning experience and provide personalized, engaging ways to master Chinese vocabulary. We're also thrilled to announce that Chapter 2 is in its final stages and will be available soon!

[h2]Time Shards: Your Personalized Learning Tool[/h2]

Learning a new language is a journey, and everyone has words and phrases that need a bit more practice. To address this, we're introducing Time Shards—a fun and interactive way to reinforce your vocabulary skills.

[h3]How It Works[/h3]

When you get a word wrong during conversations with NPCs, a new Time Shard is created. These shards are fractures in time you need to repair. To interact with these shards, you’ll use the EchoSpect Goggles, a special device that lets you see and engage with the Time Shards scattered throughout the game world.

[h3]The EchoSpect Goggles:[/h3]

The EchoSpect Goggles are set to transform your learning experience. By wearing these goggles, you can spot the Time Shards scattered throughout the environment. Each shard contains a word or phrase that needs attention. Interacting with these shards will help you reinforce your understanding and ensure you master the vocabulary and get home.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42001728/ed1b4b91cc999a63372ec5148a90fe1946ed3ad0.jpg[/img]

[h2]The Temporal Tablet: Track Your Progress[/h2]

Alongside the Time Shards, we’re introducing the Temporal Tablet. This handy tool will keep track of your Time Shards and overall progress with both vocabulary and quests.

[h3]Features:[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Progress Tracking[/b]: Monitor your mastery of vocabulary words and see which ones you need to practice more.
[*] [b]Quest Log[/b]: Keep an eye on your quest progress and see how far you’ve come in your adventure with Mulan.
[*] [b]Interactive Learning[/b]: The Temporal Tablet will provide tips and feedback based on your interactions with the Time Shards, helping you focus on areas that need improvement.
[/list]

[h2]Wrapping Up Chapter 2[/h2]

We’re also excited to let you know that Chapter 2 is nearly complete and will be available soon. In this chapter, you’ll finally meet Mulan and help her prepare for her journey by gathering necessary supplies. The new chapter promises more engaging content, exciting plot twists, and plenty of opportunities to practice your Chinese.

Stay tuned for these updates and more. We can’t wait for you to experience the new features and continue your adventure in Hua Mulan: A Chinese Learning Adventure!

Happy learning and adventuring!

The Odeum Team

notes.title: Update notes for Feb 24th
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42001728/0eba0b5f63eab1f38265df413ff8b67823097857.png[/img]

Dear Adventurers,

First and foremost, we want to express our deepest gratitude to all of you who have embarked on the journey through "Hua Mulan: A Chinese Learning Adventure." Your feedback over the past two weeks has been invaluable, not only in guiding our improvements but also in shaping the future of our game. Thanks to your insights and reports, we're excited to announce a significant update now available on Steam!

[b]What's New:[/b]

[b]Updated Chapter Menu:[/b] We've revamped the chapter menu for clarity. Now, it's easier to see which chapters you've completed and to restart your adventure from any point, ensuring a smoother journey through ancient China.

[b]Increased Stability:[/b] Many of you pointed out occasional issues and crashes. We've rolled up our sleeves and addressed these concerns, enhancing the overall stability of the game for a more seamless experience.

[b]Improved Frame Rate:[/b] To make your adventure as immersive as possible, we've optimized our scenes to significantly increase the frame rate. Get ready for a smoother and more responsive journey through Mulan's story.

[b]Gameplay Tweaks:[/b] Based on your suggestions, we've made numerous adjustments to the gameplay. These tweaks are designed to enrich your learning and playing experience, making every moment in ancient China even more engaging.

We are committed to continuously improving "Hua Mulan: A Chinese Learning Adventure" and we couldn't do it without your support. Please keep the feedback coming, as it helps us make the game better for everyone.

Thank you for being an essential part of our community and for your continued support. Here's to many more adventures together!

Warm regards,

The "Hua Mulan: A Chinese Learning Adventure" Development Team

P.S. We're always here to listen. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions for further improvements, don't hesitate to reach out through our Steam Community page or directly through the support contact on our Steam Store page. Happy adventuring!

notes.title: Our Journey Together: "Hua Mulan: A Chinese Learning Adventure"
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42001728/4da42b6022077e10115f9ff1f4fcacf822ed45fd.jpg[/img]

Dear "Hua Mulan: A Chinese Learning Adventure" Community,

As I sit down to write this message, my heart is filled with a blend of excitement, gratitude, and a deep sense of accomplishment. After several years of development, filled with countless hours of hard work, dedication, and invaluable feedback from all of you, I am overjoyed to announce that our game, "Hua Mulan: A Chinese Learning Adventure," will officially launch on Steam this Lunar New Year!

This journey began with a simple yet ambitious dream: to create a game that was not just fun to play but also offered a meaningful and immersive way to learn Chinese. We wanted to break new ground, to blend education with entertainment in a way that hadn't been done before. And now, seeing that dream become a reality feels surreal.

I want to take a moment to express my heartfelt thanks to each and every one of you in our community. Your patience, support, and passionate feedback have been the guiding stars of this project. There were challenges and hurdles along the way, but your encouragement and belief in what we were creating kept us going. You were a part of our team, every step of the way.

Launching in sync with the Lunar New Year is symbolic for us. It’s a time of new beginnings, of setting forth on new journeys, and what better way to do that than with the story of Mulan, a tale of courage, adventure, and discovery. We can't wait for you to step into ancient China, to learn and grow with each quest, and to write your own story in the annals of time.

As we approach the release date, I want to reaffirm our commitment to not just launching a game, but to creating an ongoing, evolving experience. We are eagerly looking forward to your continued feedback and involvement post-launch, to grow and refine the game further.

So, mark your calendars for February 7th, and get ready to embark on an unforgettable adventure. The legend of Mulan awaits your participation. Thank you for being such an integral part of this journey, and here’s to the many more adventures we'll have together!

With immense gratitude,

Ian Natzmer
CEO
Odeum.ai


We're committed to making "Hua Mulan: A Chinese Learning Adventure" not just a game, but a community, a learning experience, and an adventure that we all embark on together. Thank you for being a part of it!

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
Dear Odeum Community,

We're excited to bring you the latest development update on our upcoming game, Hua Mulan: A Chinese Learning Adventure. Our dedicated team has been hard at work, and we're thrilled to announce that we are finishing up development on the first chapter!

In this initial chapter, players find themselves awakening in a mysterious lab, where they're invited to join the Clockwork Time Authority. Their first mission? To investigate a time disturbance from the year 436 AD, a disturbance that intriguingly seems to revolve around the legendary figure Hua Mulan.

The gameplay combines an immersive storyline with language learning. As players navigate their way through the mission, they'll have the opportunity to learn 12 Chinese words and construct various sentences using these new vocabulary items. We've designed the game to make language learning - often a repetitive process - fun and engaging. Players will recognize Chinese characters, learn their meanings, and practice pronunciation, aided by our integrated Pinyin teaching system.

Upon journeying back to Ancient China to investigate the time disturbance, players will discover chaos sown by the mischievous time bandits, "Shadows of the Past". This will set them on a thrilling journey, traveling further back in time to unravel the unfolding mystery.

We are now in the final stages of testing Chapter 1. Feedback from our initial testing has been invaluable, and we're excited to announce that we'll be expanding the size of our Closed Beta! If you're passionate about gaming, education, and are eager to help us shape Hua Mulan into a top-tier educational adventure, we'd love to have you onboard.

Our call to action for you today is to join our Closed Beta. Be among the first to experience the exciting world of Hua Mulan, while also playing a critical role in helping us refine the game. [url=https://www.odeumlearning.com/mulan_beta/]Click here to join the Closed Beta![/url]

We're eager to share this journey with you. Thank you for your support, and we look forward to seeing you in the world of Hua Mulan!

Best,
The Odeum Team

notes.title: Creating Immersive Educational Worlds [DevBlog]
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42001728/277921f511688eaf7248a93643056d2463bccb5c.png[/img]

The challenge of creating engaging educational games lies in striking the perfect balance between learning objectives and compelling game design. At Odeum, our goal is to create immersive worlds that not only entertain players but also provide meaningful educational experiences. In this blog post, we will explore how we've achieved this balance in our upcoming game, Hua Mulan: A Chinese Learning Adventure.

[h2]Understanding the Learning Objectives[/h2]
The first step in developing an immersive educational world is to clearly define the learning objectives. For Hua Mulan, our primary focus is to teach the Chinese language and introduce players to Chinese culture through an engaging storyline. We carefully select and integrate language learning elements, such as reading, writing pinyin, and speaking Chinese, into the gameplay to ensure a comprehensive learning experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42001728/a20ed5132202e79dd984277a1e52bd3ac4baba8a.png[/img]

[h2]Creating a Rich and Engaging Story[/h2]
A captivating story is crucial to drawing players into the game world and motivating them to learn. In Hua Mulan, we've crafted an intriguing time-traveling adventure that sees players assisting the legendary Hua Mulan in foiling the evil plot of the time-traveling Shadows of the Past. By intertwining the story with language learning tasks, players are immersed in an authentic, story-driven experience.

[h2]Designing Contextualized Learning Experiences[/h2]
In Hua Mulan, we use experiential learning to maximize player engagement. We create contextualized learning experiences by placing language learning tasks within the game's narrative and environment. For example, players practice Chinese greetings while interacting with villagers and completing quests. This approach makes learning feel like a natural part of the gameplay, rather than an isolated task.

[h2]Developing a Rich, Immersive Game World[/h2]
To create a truly immersive educational world, the game's environment, characters, and cultural elements must be authentic and engaging. In Hua Mulan, we've painstakingly researched and designed ancient Chinese environments and characters, providing players with an immersive and culturally-rich experience. This attention to detail not only enhances the game's entertainment value but also supports the learning objectives by providing accurate context for language learning tasks.

[h2]Balancing Challenge and Progression[/h2]
Finally, it's essential to ensure that the game's difficulty is balanced and gradually increases as players progress. In Hua Mulan, we achieve this balance by tailoring language learning tasks to the player's skill level and offering support when needed. This approach keeps players engaged and motivated, while also ensuring that they are continually challenged and learning.

[h2]Final Thoughts[/h2]
By blending learning objectives with compelling game design, we've created an immersive educational world in Hua Mulan that not only entertains players but also fosters a genuine love for learning. We believe that this fusion of education and entertainment is the future of EdTech, and we're excited to share Hua Mulan: A Chinese Learning Adventure with players around the world.

As we get closer to release you will see us posting more often and being more active with the community. Please share your thoughts and feedback!
